relationships.subject: ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: The projection from the ACC to the dorsolateral and lateral parts of the periaqueductal gray (dl/lPAG) especially enhances both reflexive and active avoidance behavior toward pain.

key_findings: The ACC to dl/lPAG projection enhances reflexive and active avoidance of pain; increased ACC to dl/lPAG signal may drive excessive fear avoidance in chronic pain.
